result.summary: The page is largely well-formed, but the promotional banner has a serious text contrast problem, and there are a couple of minor truncation/clipping issues at the screen edges.

issues.description: The promo banner text ('3 free deliveries for you' and 'Use code TALLINN3 at checkout · min. order €10') is white/very light on a pale mint-green background, making it barely readable and failing WCAG contrast requirements.
issues.suggestion: Darken the banner background or change the text to a dark green/charcoal color to achieve at least 4.5:1 contrast ratio.

issues.description: A category filter chip after 'Healthy' is clipped almost entirely off the right edge, appearing as a sliver of an empty pill with no visible label.
issues.suggestion: Adjust chip spacing/peek amount so the partially visible chip shows enough of its label to hint at horizontal scrolling, or add a fade/gradient edge indicator.

issues.description: In the 'Fastest near you' carousel, the third restaurant name is cut off mid-word ('Trattoria Piccol...') without an ellipsis, looking abruptly clipped.
issues.suggestion: Apply text truncation with an ellipsis, or ensure card labels wrap/truncate gracefully within the visible card width.

issues.description: The '3 free deliveries' banner CTA area and text alignment feel unbalanced because the low-contrast text makes the 'Order now' button appear to float in an empty green block.
issues.suggestion: Once text contrast is fixed, verify the visual hierarchy so the headline, subtext, and button form a clear grouped layout.
